title: Severity & Patch Triage
objective: Memutuskan emergency fix, maintenance fix, documentation fix, defer, flag-off, atau rollback.
limits: Fixture lokal dependency-free; register kosong tetap BLOCKED tanpa klaim incident atau decision. Tidak membuktikan incident nyata, tracker eksternal, native GUI, hosted CI, credential/auth expiry, signing public-trust, hardware, telemetry produksi, atau publikasi; gate eksternal DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
